title: Cross-slice owners & estimate grid (ad-hoc)
content:
Summary: One-off tracker to align owners and effort estimates for small cross-functional fixes and opt-ops items surfaced in the last week. Use this to quickly decide who to ping and whether to schedule or defer.

Columns: Item ID | Short description | Owner | Team | Priority (1-5) | Est hrs | ETA (wk) | Blockers | Decision

Rows:
1 | Reroute fallback policy for eu-west burst | Daniel Park | infrastructure | 2 | 12 | 2029-06-20 | confirm capacity mapping to dedicated pool | schedule quick patch
2 | Low-throughput embedding cache miss rate spike | Sofia Ramos | observability | 3 | 20 | 2029-06-25 | need sample logs + bandwidth metrics | triage + owner deep-dive
3 | Dedicated rollout rollback playbook gaps | Liam Chen | product-ops | 1 | 8 | 2029-06-18 | align on SLA wording with legal | ship minor edits
4 | Billing spike: token cost anomaly (customer X) | Aisha Patel | finance-and-legal | 1 | 16 | 2029-06-22 | require invoice and usage lines | urgent customer fw-up
5 | Canary traffic routing mismatch for v2 models | Marcus Liu | serving-runtime | 2 | 24 | 2029-07-01 | replica count and autoscaler tuning | canary pause

Notes:
- Estimates are quick single-person engineering estimates (incl. investigation) — pad for unknowns.
- If Eff hrs > 16 and Priority <=2, recommend scheduling 2-week sprint ticket.
- 'Decision' options: schedule / triage / defer / urgent

Open questions:
- Do we auto-assign infra items to on-call if ETA < 48h? (ask SRE)
- Who owns cross-regional capacity tagging convention? (possible doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INFRA/capacity-tags)

Next steps:
- Owners to update actual time spent in the row after completion.
- PD to convert high-effort items into GH issues and assign milestone.
- Product-ops to run weekly 15-min sync on Monday to clear 'triage' bucket.
